title: The Guild Offices
text:
*The Merchants' Guild offices are near the harbor — a grand building for a city this size, with a gilded sign and iron-barred windows. You wait until the last clerk leaves, then make your move.*

*The lock on the side door yields to your picks. Inside, the offices are immaculate — mahogany desks, leather-bound ledgers, the smell of expensive ink. Harren's personal office is on the upper floor.*

*His desk is locked, but the lock is no match for your skills. Inside, you find a leather portfolio containing a complete operations plan: dates, quantities, contacts outside the city. And a letter — sealed with the crest of Baron Varketh, a minor warlord from the eastern marches.*

*Harren isn't acting alone. He's a puppet — or a partner — of an outside power. Baron Varketh means to take Ashenmoor, and Harren is opening the door.*

choices.text: Take the entire portfolio — this is the proof you need
Copy the key details and leave everything undisturbed
Forge a reply to Baron Varketh using Harren's seal, feeding false information
